RagShortTexts: In 1268, Baibars seized and razed Antioch, extinguishing one of the oldest Crusader states.

Variants.Content: In May 1268, Sultan Baibars brought catastrophic ruin upon the Principality of Antioch. Breaching monumental Roman-era bastions in mere days, Mamluk forces plundered the ancient Christian capital, putting garrisons to the sword and levelling ducal palaces in retribution for Frankish-Mongol alliances.
Baibars's infamous mocking letter to Prince Bohemond VI sealed the irrecoverable collapse of northern Outremer.
